subject.why: The ship's stove, pot of stew, and brass porthole match the brief clearly.

category.why: The stove sits solidly on a wide floor with a simplified galley backdrop.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, or characters are present.

framing.why: The subject is centrally placed with balanced margins on all sides.

colour.why: Warm, vibrant tones provide clear contrast between the stove and background.

detail.why: Volumes remain chunky and clean without distracting micro-textures.

style.why: Rendered with smooth forms and satin highlights matching the reference style.
